entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Karl Höfer also Hoefer; was a German Lieutenant general during World War I he became known as the Held vom Kemmelberge
(hero of Kemmel hill) after his division had captured the Kemmelberg during the Fourth Battle of Flanders.
